_comment: Identifiers of the DEVELOPMENT environment. Not secret; committed on purpose. scripts/release_preflight.py (gates c and d) fails a release whose production Firebase project id or media buckets equal any value below, so test sign-ups and test photos can never land in production. When development moves to its own Firebase project or buckets, list the new names here too. Details: docs/deployment/11-environments.md, section Development identifiers.
